blurb: Come ride the restored river boat, Rose Lummis, on Sodus Bay! Save our Sodus offers 90 minute cruises between May 8th and September 27th, leaving from Oak Park Marina in North Rose, NY. Whether you're taking the kids on an eco-tour, or getting an guided history and wildlife cruise, or simply soaking up the sunset with local music, food and wine -- we invite you to experience Sodus Bay on board the Rose
